question.en:
Case Study -
A company is building a web-based AI application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring.
The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3.
The company needs to use the central model registry to manage different versions of models in the application.
Which action will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
question.ja:
ケーススタディ -
ある企業は、Amazon SageMaker を使用してWebベースのAIアプリケーションを構築しています。このアプリケーションは、ML実験、トレーニング、中央モデルレジストリ、モデルデプロイ、モデルモニタリングという機能を提供します。
このアプリケーションは、MLライフサイクル全体を通じてトレーニングデータを安全かつ分離された状態で使用できる必要があります。トレーニングデータは Amazon S3 に保存されています。
この企業は、アプリケーション内のモデルの異なるバージョンを管理するために、中央モデルレジストリを使用する必要があります。
最小の運用負荷でこの要件を満たすアクションはどれですか。

text.en: Create a separate Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository for each model.
text.ja: モデルごとに個別の Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) リポジトリを作成する。

text.en: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and unique tags for each model version.
text.ja: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) を使用し、モデルバージョンごとに一意のタグを付ける。

text.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models.
text.ja: SageMaker Model Registry とモデルグループを使用してモデルをカタログ化する。

text.en: Use the SageMaker Model Registry and unique tags for each model version.
text.ja: SageMaker Model Registry を使用し、モデルバージョンごとに一意のタグを付ける。

comment.en: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-registry-models.html "Each model package in a Model Group corresponds to a trained model. The version of each model package is a numerical value that starts at 1 and is incremented with each new model package added to a Model Group. For example, if 5 model packages are added to a Model Group, the model package versions will be 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5."
https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/centralize-model-governance-with-sagemaker-model-registry-resource-access-manager-sharing/

The correct answer is C. Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models. SageMaker Model Registry is specifically designed for managing ML models within the SageMaker ecosystem. It provides built-in versioning and cataloging capabilities for ML models. Model groups in the Model Registry allow for logical organization of related models. It integrates seamlessly with other SageMaker components like training, deployment, and monitoring. This solution offers the least operational overhead as it's a native SageMaker feature designed for this exact purpose. It provides features like model approval workflows, which are crucial for managing models in production environments.

SageMaker Model Registry is specifically designed for managing ML models within the SageMaker ecosystem. It provides built-in versioning and cataloging capabilities for ML models. Model groups in the Model Registry allow for logical organization of related models. It integrates seamlessly with other SageMaker components like training, deployment, and monitoring. This solution offers the least operational overhead as it's a native SageMaker feature designed for this exact purpose. It provides features like model approval workflows, which are crucial for managing models in production environments.

C: The SageMaker Model Registry organizes models into Model Package Groups, tracks versions as Model Packages, and optionally aggregates groups into Collections. This structure ensures robust versioning and manageability for trained models. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-registry-models.html
Use model group
least operation is the keyword here

C. Use the SageMaker Model Registry and model groups to catalog the models. This approach leverages SageMaker's built-in features, reducing the need for external systems like ECR and minimizing operational complexity by using model groups for organized versioning.
Amazon SageMaker Model Registry creates Catalog models for production and Manage model versions.

Amazon SageMaker Model Registry is specifically designed to manage and catalog models in a centralized way, including versioning, approval workflows, and deployment history. It simplifies the process of managing different versions of models, which aligns with the company's requirement to use a central model registry.

A. No, ECR is used to store container images B. No, ECR is used to store container images C. Yes D. No, Each model package in a Model Group corresponds to a trained model. The version of each model package is a numerical value that starts at 1 and is incremented with each new model package added to a Model Group - https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-registry-models.html

explanation.ja:
正解は C。

SageMaker Model Registry はモデルとそのバージョンを管理するために作られた中央レジストリで、モデルグループを使うとモデルの異なるバージョンをまとめてカタログ化できる。フルマネージドで承認ワークフローやバージョン管理の機能も備えているため、最小の運用負荷で要件を満たせる。

- A: モデルごとにECRリポジトリを作るのは運用負荷が高く、ECRはコンテナイメージ用のサービスでモデルのバージョン管理機能を持たない。
- B: ECRにタグを付ける方法もコンテナイメージのタグ付けにすぎず、モデルレジストリとしてのメタデータ管理・承認機能がない。
- D: SageMaker Model Registry自体は正しいが、モデルバージョンにタグを付けるだけではモデルグループによるカタログ化を活用しておらず、Cの方法が適切。

question.en:
Case Study -

The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3.
The company is experimenting with consecutive training jobs.
How can the company MINIMIZE infrastructure startup times for these jobs?
question.ja:
ケーススタディ -
ある企業は、Amazon SageMaker を使用してWebベースのAIアプリケーションを構築しています。このアプリケーションは、ML実験、トレーニング、中央モデルレジストリ、モデルデプロイ、モデルモニタリングという機能を提供します。

この企業は、連続したトレーニングジョブの実験を行っています。
これらのジョブのインフラ起動時間を最小化するには、どうすればよいですか。

text.en: Use Managed Spot Training.
text.ja: Managed Spot Training を使用する。

text.en: Use SageMaker managed warm pools.
text.ja: SageMaker のマネージドウォームプールを使用する。

text.en: Use SageMaker Training Compiler.
text.ja: SageMaker Training Compiler を使用する。

text.en: Use the SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) library.
text.ja: SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) ライブラリを使用する。

comment.en: SageMaker managed warm pools allow instances to stay in a ready state between consecutive training jobs, which minimizes infrastructure startup times. This feature is ideal for scenarios with frequent or consecutive training jobs, as it avoids the time-consuming process of provisioning infrastructure for each job.

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/train-warm-pools.html#train-warm-pools-how-it-works SageMaker managed warm pools let you retain and reuse provisioned infrastructure after the completion of a training job to reduce latency for repetitive workloads, such as iterative experimentation or running many jobs consecutively.

SageMaker managed warm pools allow instances to stay in a ready state between consecutive training jobs, which minimizes infrastructure startup times. This feature is ideal for scenarios with frequent or consecutive training jobs, as it avoids the time-consuming process of provisioning infrastructure for each job.

A. No, Managed Spot Training is used to reduce the compute cost for training B. Yes, Warm Pool allow to retain and re-use provisioned infrastructure, also use a persistent cache to store data across training job and help reduce infrastructure startup time as well as cost - https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/train-warm-pools.html C. No, SageMaker Training Compiler is used to optimize your code for a specific target architecture D. No, the SageMaker distributed data parallelism (SMDDP) library is used parallelize training by distributing data across multiple instances. This doesn't reduce infrastructure startu ptime
https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2022/09/reduce-ml-model-training-job-startup-time-8x-sagemaker-training-managed-warm-pools/

SageMaker managed warm pools are designed to reduce infrastructure startup times by keeping the training environment (instances, containers, and environment setup) ready between consecutive training jobs.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/train-warm-pools.html "which speeds up start times by reducing the time spent provisioning resources."

explanation.ja:
正解は B。

SageMakerのマネージドウォームプールは、トレーニングジョブ終了後も一定時間インフラを保持しておき、次のジョブで再利用できる機能。連続してトレーニングジョブを実行する場合、インスタンスの起動処理をスキップできるため、インフラの起動時間を最小化できる。

- A: Managed Spot Trainingはスポット容量を使ってコストを削減する仕組みで、起動時間の短縮とは関係がなく、中断によりむしろ時間がかかることもある。
- C: SageMaker Training Compilerはトレーニング自体の実行速度を最適化するもので、インフラの起動時間には影響しない。
- D: SMDDPは複数ノード間の分散トレーニングを高速化するライブラリであり、インフラ起動時間の短縮とは無関係。

question.en:

A company is building a web-based AI application by using Amazon SageMaker. The application will provide the following capabilities and features: ML experimentation, training, a central model registry, model deployment, and model monitoring.
The application must ensure secure and isolated use of training data during the ML lifecycle. The training data is stored in Amazon S3.
The company must implement a manual approval-based workflow to ensure that only approved models can be deployed to production endpoints.
Which solution will meet this requirement?
question.ja:
ケーススタディ -
ある企業は、Amazon SageMaker を使用してWebベースのAIアプリケーションを構築しています。このアプリケーションは、ML実験、トレーニング、中央モデルレジストリ、モデルデプロイ、モデルモニタリングという機能を提供します。

text.en: Use SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking on the central model registry. Create tracking entities for the approval process.
text.ja: 中央モデルレジストリで SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking を使用する。承認プロセス用のトラッキングエンティティを作成する。

text.ja: SageMaker Pipelines を使用する。モデルバージョンが登録されたら、AWS SDK を使用して承認ステータスを「Approved」に変更する。

comment.en: This tricked my as option D is not clearly worded: A. No, SageMaker Experiments allows to track and organize your experiment but not for approving models B. No, SageMaker ML Lineage Tracking allows to track model lineage but do not allow to approve a model C. No, SageMaker Model Monitor allows to monitor data quality, model quality, bias and feature attribution D. Yes, After you create a model version, you typically evaluate its performance and then update the approval status of the model version. You can update the approval status of a model version by using the SDK, SageMaker Studio console or with a condition step in a SageMaker AI pipeline
The SageMaker Model Registry within the pipeline provides functionality to manually or programmatically approve models for production deployment.
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_us/sagemaker/latest/dg/model-registry-approve.html "You can update the approval status of a model version by using the AWS SDK "
The SageMaker Model Registry within the pipeline provides functionality to manually or programmatically approve models for production deployment.

SageMaker Pipelines is designed to orchestrate machine learning workflows, including manual approval steps for model registration. You can define a step in the pipeline where a manual approval process is required before the model's status is changed to "Approved" for deployment.
The SageMaker Model Registry within the pipeline provides functionality to manually or programmatically approve models for production deployment

explanation.ja:
正解は D。

SageMaker Pipelinesでモデルをモデルレジストリに登録すると、承認ステータス(PendingManualApproval)が付与される。AWS SDKを使ってこのステータスを明示的に「Approved」に変更する仕組みにすることで、手動承認ベースのワークフローを実装でき、承認されたモデルのみを本番デプロイの対象にできる。

- A: SageMaker Experimentsは実験や指標のトラッキング用の機能であり、承認プロセスを直接サポートするものではない。
- B: ML Lineage Trackingはモデルの系譜（データやプロセスの追跡）を記録する機能で、承認ワークフローの機能を持たない。
- C: Model Monitorはデプロイ後のモデル品質やデータドリフトを監視する機能であり、承認プロセスの管理には使えない。

question.en:
Case study -
An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model on AWS. The training dataset includes transaction logs, customer profiles, and tables from an on-premises MySQL database. The transaction logs and customer profiles are stored in Amazon S3.
The dataset has a class imbalance that affects the learning of the model's algorithm. Additionally, many of the features have interdependencies. The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data.
Which AWS service or feature can aggregate the data from the various data sources?
question.ja:
ケーススタディ -
ある機械学習(ML)エンジニアが、AWS上で不正検知モデルを開発しています。トレーニングデータセットには、トランザクションログ、顧客プロファイル、およびオンプレミスの MySQL データベースのテーブルが含まれています。トランザクションログと顧客プロファイルは Amazon S3 に保存されています。
このデータセットにはクラス不均衡があり、モデルのアルゴリズムの学習に影響を及ぼしています。さらに、多くの特徴量には相互依存関係があります。このアルゴリズムは、データ内の望ましい根本的なパターンをすべて捉えることができていません。
さまざまなデータソースからデータを集約できる AWS のサービスまたは機能はどれですか。

text.en: Amazon EMR Spark jobs
text.ja: Amazon EMR の Spark ジョブ

text.en: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
text.ja: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

text.en: Amazon DynamoDB
text.ja: Amazon DynamoDB

text.en: AWS Lake Formation
text.ja: AWS Lake Formation

comment.en: Amazon EMR with Spark is an excellent choice for aggregating, processing, and transforming large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., Amazon S3 and on-premises MySQL database). Spark jobs can handle both structured and unstructured. While Lake Formation is great for managing data lakes, it doesn’t provide the ETL and data processing capabilities required to aggregate and transform datasets from multiple sources.
Is it D? AWS Lake Formation ? EMR Spark jobs is more manual.

AWS Lake Formation is a service designed to aggregate, catalog, and manage data from multiple data sources, including on-premises databases and Amazon S3, making it an ideal choice for this scenario. While Amazon EMR with Apache Spark is powerful for processing and analyzing large datasets, it focuses more on data processing than on data aggregation and cataloging. It doesn't inherently manage interdependencies or schema enforcement

The answer is D (Lake Formation). This is because EMR Spark does not natively support getting data from on-prem DB as its data source. You would need DataSync or something else for that. On the other hand, Lake Formation fulfills all use cases documented clearly as links shown below. https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html#lake-formation-features https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-get-data-in.html
Lake Formation is the correct answer
Data Lake is used for data discovery

Lake Formation ain't only the storage service - it actually an umbrella over most AWS Glue Offerings. And cause it also provides fully serverless Spark, it seems to be better option than EMR. This point is quite tricky as often when someone refers to LF, they mean the governance part only.

The correct answer is D. AWS Lake Formation. Explanation: AWS Lake Formation is designed for aggregating, organizing, and securing large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., S3, on-premises databases). It simplifies the creation of a centralized data lake, enabling seamless integration and analysis of diverse data formats. This is particularly useful for tasks like fraud detection, where data comes from different sources. Amazon EMR Spark jobs (Option A) is more suited for large-scale data processing and analytics. While it can process and transform data, it requires more operational effort to configure and manage compared to AWS Lake Formation. Why AWS Lake Formation? Aggregates and organizes data from S3 and MySQL easily. Offers integrated data cataloging for better feature engineering. Reduces operational overhead compared to setting up EMR.
A. Amazon EMR Spark jobs
EMR with Spark can aggregate large datasets from multiple sources, including S3 and on-premises MySQL.
Amazon EMR is correct answer for aggregation
I think it is D, because EMR with SPARK is more of a compute engine, not a central aggregation service.

explanation.ja:
正解は D。

AWS Lake Formationは、S3上のデータやオンプレミスのJDBCデータソース（MySQLなど）を含む複数のデータソースを統合し、ガバナンスされたデータレイクとして集約するためのサービス。トランザクションログ、顧客プロファイル、オンプレミスDBのテーブルを一元的に扱えるようにするのに適している。

- A: Amazon EMRのSparkジョブはデータ処理には使えるが、複数の異種データソースを統合的にカタログ化・集約するためのガバナンス機能は持たない。
- B: Kinesis Data Streamsはリアルタイムストリーミングデータの取り込み用であり、既存の保存済みデータを集約する用途には合わない。
- C: DynamoDBはNoSQLデータベースであり、データを保存・提供するためのものでデータ集約の仕組みではない。

question.en:
Case study -
An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model on AWS. The training dataset includes transaction logs, customer profiles, and tables from an on-premises MySQL database. The transaction logs and customer profiles are stored in Amazon S3.
The dataset has a class imbalance that affects the learning of the model's algorithm. Additionally, many of the features have interdependencies. The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data.
Before the ML engineer trains the model, the ML engineer must resolve the issue of the imbalanced data.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?
question.ja:
ケーススタディ -
ある機械学習(ML)エンジニアが、AWS上で不正検知モデルを開発しています。トレーニングデータセットには、トランザクションログ、顧客プロファイル、およびオンプレミスの MySQL データベースのテーブルが含まれています。トランザクションログと顧客プロファイルは Amazon S3 に保存されています。
このデータセットにはクラス不均衡があり、モデルのアルゴリズムの学習に影響を及ぼしています。さらに、多くの特徴量には相互依存関係があります。このアルゴリズムは、データ内の望ましい根本的なパターンをすべて捉えることができていません。
モデルをトレーニングする前に、このMLエンジニアはデータの不均衡の問題を解決する必要があります。
最小の運用負荷でこの要件を満たすソリューションはどれですか。

text.en: Use Amazon Athena to identify patterns that contribute to the imbalance. Adjust the dataset accordingly.
text.ja: Amazon Athena を使用して不均衡の原因となっているパターンを特定する。それに応じてデータセットを調整する。

text.en: Use Amazon SageMaker Studio Classic built-in algorithms to process the imbalanced dataset.
text.ja: Amazon SageMaker Studio Classic の組み込みアルゴリズムを使用して、不均衡なデータセットを処理する。

text.en: Use AWS Glue DataBrew built-in features to oversample the minority class.
text.ja: AWS Glue DataBrew の組み込み機能を使用して、少数クラスをオーバーサンプリングする。

text.en: Use the Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler balance data operation to oversample the minority class.
text.ja: Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler の balance data 操作を使用して、少数クラスをオーバーサンプリングする。

comment.en: LEAST effort https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/balance-your-data-for-machine-learning-with-amazon-sagemaker-data-wrangler/
SageMaker Data Wrangler provides balance data and handle imbalance with minimum efforts.
SageMaker Data Wrangler provides a "balance data" operation designed to handle class imbalance.

Both Glue DataBrew and Data Wrangler allows data preparation for ML with no-code/low-code (aka low ops effort). However, Data Wrangler provides built-in transformation for balancing dataset (random oversampling, random undersampling and smote) https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/data-wrangler-transform.html#data-wrangler-transform-balance-data while DataBrew doesn't provide built-in recipe step for balancing dataset, actually it provides a smaller set of data science recipe steps limited to binarization, bucketization, categorical mapping, one-hot encoding, scaling, skewness and tokenization https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/recipe-actions.data-science.html

explanation.ja:
正解は D。

SageMaker Data WranglerにはGUIで使える「balance data」という組み込み変換操作があり、少数クラスのオーバーサンプリング（SMOTEなど）をノーコードで実行できる。これによりコードを書かずに最小の運用負荷でクラス不均衡を解消できる。

- A: Athenaはクエリサービスであり、パターンの特定はできてもオーバーサンプリングなどのバランス調整機能自体は提供しない。
- B: SageMaker Studio Classicの「組み込みアルゴリズム」という表現は不均衡データ処理専用の機能を指すものではなく、この目的に直接使えるものではない。
- C: AWS Glue DataBrewは主にデータクリーニング・変換用のツールで、クラスバランス調整のための組み込みオーバーサンプリング機能は持たない。

question.en:
Case study -
An ML engineer is developing a fraud detection model on AWS. The training dataset includes transaction logs, customer profiles, and tables from an on-premises MySQL database. The transaction logs and customer profiles are stored in Amazon S3.
The dataset has a class imbalance that affects the learning of the model's algorithm. Additionally, many of the features have interdependencies. The algorithm is not capturing all the desired underlying patterns in the data.
The ML engineer needs to use an Amazon SageMaker built-in algorithm to train the model.
Which algorithm should the ML engineer use to meet this requirement?
question.ja:

ある機械学習(ML)エンジニアが、AWS上で不正検知モデルを開発しています。トレーニングデータセットには、トランザクションログ、顧客プロファイル、およびオンプレミスの MySQL データベースのテーブルが含まれています。トランザクションログと顧客プロファイルは Amazon S3 に保存されています。

このMLエンジニアは、モデルのトレーニングに Amazon SageMaker の組み込みアルゴリズムを使用する必要があります。
この要件を満たすには、どのアルゴリズムを使用すべきですか。

text.en: LightGBM
text.ja: LightGBM

text.en: Linear learner
text.ja: Linear learner

text.en: К-means clustering

text.ja: Neural Topic Model (NTM)

comment.en: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_kr/sagemaker/latest/dg/lightgbm.html
Answer is B

Here's why LightGBM is the most suitable algorithm for this fraud detection task: Handling Class Imbalance: LightGBM is particularly effective at handling imbalanced datasets, which is a key issue mentioned in the problem statement. It has built-in mechanisms to deal with class imbalance. Feature Interdependencies: LightGBM can capture complex feature interactions through its tree-based structure, addressing the issue of feature interdependencies mentioned in the problem. Capturing Underlying Patterns: As an advanced gradient boosting framework, LightGBM is excellent at capturing complex patterns in data, which the current algorithm is struggling with. Suitable for Fraud Detection: LightGBM is widely used in fraud detection tasks due to its high performance and ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Handling Various Data Types: It can work well with the mix of data types likely present in transaction logs, customer profiles, and database tables.

We have an unbalanced dataset, this means we have labelled dataset thus we are going to use a supervised model training. This reduce options to A and B (K-means and NTM are unsupervised). Both LightGBM and Linear Learner provides hyperparameter to manage unbalanced datasets, respectively "scale-pos_weight" and "positive_example_weight_mult". I would go for LightGBM as this algorithm is more suited to handle complex relationship among features, while Linear Learner learns a linear function, or, for classification problems, a linear threshold function, and maps a vector x to an approximation of the label y.

1. Clase desbalanceada: LightGBM (Light Gradient Boosted Machine) es muy eficaz para trabajar con datasets desbalanceados, gracias a su capacidad para ajustar los pesos de clases y usar técnicas como el weighted loss o boosting adaptativo. 2. Interdependencia entre variables: LightGBM puede capturar relaciones no lineales e interacciones entre variables gracias a su estructura basada en árboles de decisión. Esto lo hace más adecuado que modelos lineales como el Linear Learner, que solo captura relaciones lineales. 3. No captura de patrones complejos: La descripción indica que el algoritmo actual no está capturando patrones subyacentes complejos, lo que sugiere la necesidad de un modelo más robusto como LightGBM, capaz de modelar relaciones complejas y no lineales en los datos
ChatGPT say it's A: LightGBM
Is supported by Sagemaker
https://docs.aws.amazon.com/en_kr/sagemaker/latest/dg/lightgbm.html
This is a binary classification problem so LightGBM so be used. Other algorithms are not for binary classification.
